body.resource_hint: For A=R_t P_0 R_t^dagger on the certified covariant Laurent algebra, delta A=0 implies A_q=0 for q!=0. In an Eq. (19) split A=N_0+Q_<0, directness forces Q_<0=0 and N_0=A. Ghost evenness then requires kappa A_1 kappa=A_1, but A_1=Z^-1[K_+,P_0] is rank four while its kappa image has independent Z support; the canonical odd norm is -7/288. Formal coefficient uniqueness prevents higher-order repair, and unit preservation prevents a regular same-chart source parity from supplying the missing Z branch.
